title: 第7章 豪门千金（7）-《反派BOSS有毒》
content:
第(1/3)页

    坐公交车绝对是楚棠这辈子第一次尝试，下车的时候，他是极其不舒服的，但是为了维持形象，楚少爷强撑着继续装逼。

    时笙倒没讽刺他，不过也不同情，谁让他把司机叫走的。

    叫回来还要收钱，怎么不钻钱眼里去。

    时笙带楚棠去公园溜了一圈，最后走着回家，两人相处得让系统都有些看不下去了。

    这打起来，它都不觉得奇怪。

    系统已经预见隐藏任务失败的场面……

    时笙快到家了，楚棠都没要走的意思，“楚先生，你不回去？”

    楚棠双手插在裤兜，往别墅区走，“我现在是属于许小姐的，自然要跟着许小姐回家。”

    回……家？

    时笙嘴角抽搐，这楚棠脑子是有坑吧？

    不管楚棠脑子有没有坑，楚棠都跟着时笙回了家，许父还没睡，坐在沙发上诡异的看家庭伦理剧，看到时笙和一个陌生男人进来。

    愣了下，随后跳了起来，大吼，“丫头，你竟然带个男人回家！”

    吼完才看清楚棠的面貌，嗯，这不是那天那个男人吗？

    楚棠！

    许父眸子一亮，激动得有些手足无措，“楚先生？”

    楚棠微微笑了下，“许总，打扰了。”

    “不打扰不打扰，楚先生能光临寒舍，真是蓬荜生辉，快请坐。丫头愣着干什么？快去沏茶！”

    时笙：“……”

    刚才你还吼本宝宝带男人回来呢！眨眼你就叛变了，这是亲爹嘛！

    等时笙泡好茶出来，许父已经和楚棠聊上了。

    等时笙上去换身衣裳下来，许父已经不叫楚先生了，叫小楚了！偏偏小楚，呸，楚棠还应了！应了！

    她换个衣裳的时间发生了神马？这两人的友谊得到了质的升华吗？

    时间太晚，许父也不好拉着楚棠聊太多，督促着时笙给楚棠准备房间什么的，那样子恨不得把她打包塞到楚棠被窝里……

    就算人家大腿粗，也不用这么卖女求荣吧！？

    “丫头，加油，爸爸看好你！”许父冲着时笙做了个加油的手势。

    时笙：“……”

    #亲爹的脑回路有点无法理解系列#
    第(1/3)页

Page (1/3)

It was definitely Chu Tang’s first time in his life to take a bus. When he got off the bus, he was extremely uncomfortable, but in order to maintain his image, Master Chu forced himself on and continued to show off.

Shi Sheng didn't ridicule him, but he didn't sympathize with him either. Who asked him to call the driver away.

​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​: Why don't you take advantage of the money and ask for money?

Shi Sheng took Chu Tang to the park for a walk, and finally walked home. The two got along so well that the system couldn't stand it anymore.

It doesn’t even feel weird about this fight.

The system has foreseen the failure of the hidden mission...

Shi Sheng was almost home, and Chu Tang had no intention of leaving, "Mr. Chu, aren't you going back?"

Chu Tang put his hands in his trouser pockets and walked towards the villa area, "I belong to Miss Xu now, so naturally I have to follow Miss Xu home."

Back to...home?

Shi Sheng’s mouth twitched. Is there something wrong with Chu Tang’s brain?

Regardless of whether Chu Tang had a problem in his mind, Chu Tang followed Shi Sheng back home. Xu's father was not asleep yet, sitting on the sofa watching a family ethics drama in a weird way, when he saw Shi Sheng coming in with a strange man.

He was stunned for a moment, then jumped up and yelled, "Girl, you actually brought a man home!"

After yelling, I could see Tang’s face clearly. Well, isn’t this the man that day?

Chu Tang!

Father Xu’s eyes lit up and he was so excited that he felt at a loss, “Mr. Chu?”

Chu Tang smiled slightly and said, "Mr. Xu, excuse me."

"Don't bother me, don't bother me. It's really wonderful that Mr. Chu can come to this humble house. Please sit down quickly. What are you doing standing there in a daze? Go and make tea!"

Shi Sheng: "..."

Just now you were yelling at me to bring a man back!You rebelled in the blink of an eye. This is your biological father!

By the time Shi Sheng made the tea, Xu's father was already chatting with Chu Tang.

"When Sheng went up to change his clothes and came down, Xu's father no longer called him Mr. Chu, but Xiao Chu!"But Xiao Chu, bah, Chu Tang responded!Yes!

What happened when she changed her clothes?Has the friendship between these two people been qualitatively sublimated?

It was too late, and Xu’s father couldn’t talk too much with Chu Tang. He urged Shi Sheng to prepare a room for Chu Tang, which made him want to pack her up and stuff her into Chu Tang’s bed...

Even if someone has thick thighs, there is no need to sell her daughter for glory!?

"Girl, come on, daddy is optimistic about you!" Xu's father made a cheering gesture towards Shi Sheng.

Shi Sheng: "..."

​ #My father’s brain circuit is a bit incomprehensible series#
